scope: One read-only Newton/MJWarp 2 ms elliptic impratio=1 dump baseline to inspect realized contact parameters and solver statistics. No production edits, training, FPS, or 830xx use.

reference_pair.pair_status: pending until the v4 run reproduces both hashes

contact_capture.timing: After env.step returns; MJWarp fields are from the final completed solver substep of that policy step.
contact_capture.valid_slice: Serialize mjw_data.contact arrays only for [0:nacon], never the padded naconmax tail.
contact_capture.body_map: Map each contact geom through mjw_model.geom_bodyid[world,geom], then record body_invweight0[world,body] (including both components and component 0 used in Newton's kf mapping).
contact_capture.shape_map: Record Newton shape index/label, mapped MuJoCo geom, shape_material_kf, shape body label, and model.mujoco.solref_mode code/name.
contact_capture.formula: Newton 1.6.1 contact kernel: tc=2/[mixed_kf*(body_invweight0[a][0]+body_invweight0[b][0])*((1-dmax)*impratio_invsqrt^2+dmax)] where dmax=contact.solimp[1]. Compare the actual contact.solreffriction[0] to this value and 2*dt=0.004 s.
contact_capture.solreffriction_format: Only a positive first solreffriction value is interpreted as a time constant for the 2dt/refsafe comparison; zero inherits normal solref and a negative value is direct-format, so those are recorded but excluded from that test.
contact_capture.refsafe: Do not alter solver disableflags. Record host and MJWarp disableflags/refsafe status if available.
contact_capture.solver_statistics: At the same four snapshots, copy solver_niter and supported candidate solver_gradient/solver_improvement/solver_fwdinv/solver_residual/solver_grad/solver_iter fields; unsupported fields are explicit NA.

official_source_evidence.newton_solver_conversion: newton/_src/solvers/mujoco/solver_mujoco.py:4643-4687 reads model.mujoco.solref_mode and writes the valid MJWarp contact arrays including solref, solreffriction, solimp, geom, efc_address and worldid.
official_source_evidence.newton_kf_map: newton/_src/solvers/mujoco/kernels.py:637-648 computes contact solreffriction timeconst from mixed shape_material_kf, body_invweight0, solimp dmax and impratio_invsqrt.
official_source_evidence.newton_test_formula: newton/tests/test_mujoco_solver.py:5073-5097 reads nacon/actual contact rows and independently calculates the same expected solreffriction time constant.
official_source_evidence.mujoco_warp_data: mujoco_warp/_src/types.py:2070-2230 documents solver_niter and the MJWarp contact data layout; unsupported solver statistics are preserved as NA.

acceptance: Runtime host and MJWarp cone/impratio fields match elliptic/1; physics configuration and existing v3 physical contract remain fixed.
Retain the full canonical reset hash and mark pairing pending if it does not equal the pinned v2 reference hash.
Retain native qd/target/integral/applied effort samples and the existing PI/cap verification.
At four policy boundaries, dump only valid MJWarp contact rows and the supported solver iteration statistics; preserve NA explicitly.
Record actual tc, independently recomputed tc, 2dt threshold, refsafe state, solver_niter, and the true runner exit code.
No additional parameter runs follow this baseline without explicit parent authorization.
